# NBV Background {#nbv-background}

This page is a short literature-oriented entry point. It does not own ARIA-NBV
theory, research questions, equations, or implementation contracts. The
canonical synthesis is in the [Typst thesis](../../typst/thesis/main.typ),
especially its foundations and method sections.

Classical next-best-view work uses geometric uncertainty, information gain, or
surface coverage. Learning-based work such as [GenNBV](../literature/gen_nbv.qmd)
[@GenNBV-chen2024] and [VIN-NBV](../literature/vin_nbv.qmd)
[@VIN-NBV-frahm2025] illustrates the transition from coverage heuristics to
quality-oriented view selection. These citations are background evidence only;
ARIA-specific claims and the current RRI formulation belong to the thesis.

For the current implementation boundary, see the Python module docstrings and
the contract tests under `tests/`. For the project research questions, use
`docs/typst/thesis/sections/01-research-questions.typ`.
